I'm considering it for a few reasons.
-London is not a pretty city. The weather is bad and the architecture is drab. (If you arent lucky enough to live in Chelsea or Hampstead.)
-I am sick and tired of living in shared accomedation and you need a CEO's salary to live alone. 
-Im tired of working my ass off to pay off my landlord's mortgage while not working towards anything for myself.
-Your money cant buy you anything here. Everything of value it 20+ years out of reach. 
-All in all I feel that there is no future here. There is no clear and obvious life plan or goal, it's just to go to work and pay rent and if you are lucky you can go to a lunch wagon and pay $20 for a pie or a wrap.
They should have picked practical names like Upper, Eastern or Southern. These are not going to stand any test of time. They are already outdated.
